note: Prompt feeder and answer rack physically connect to matching ports. The answer rack then feeds the blind judge through an uninterrupted arrow. The released weights sit separately and have no route into the evaluator. Blank trays and two classes of evidence represent the rubric without fabricated text or scores. All six labels and the detached publisher qualification were legible at 320px and clearly inside the glyph safe area.
alt_text: Released weights sit beside an evaluation in which prompts produce answers and a blind judge checks facts and framing.
native_prompt:
Render one finished static factual editorial illustration for a premium advanced textbook. Use a 1200 by 630 wide native composition; white ground, crisp dark ink, restrained indigo, teal, and terracotta highlights, clean modern large sans-serif, high-contrast flat editorial linework with subtle cutaway shading. Fill the broad white canvas with the mechanism without adding bars or shrinking a different aspect ratio. At least 12 individually useful objects and at least two visually differentiated substages. No human figures, avatars, shields, gears, logos, brands, realism, pseudo-text, microstrokes, invented gauges, controls or success marks.

Upper-left prompt fixture and lower-left weights bay meet a central answer rack, then a right comparison bench and independent caveat.

Stacked colored prompt tiles feed a left-to-center specimen slot; a separate lower-left open-weight cassette is a released artifact, with no arrow from the weights to the judge. In the center place opaque answer slips, rack, export slot and identity-cover sleeve. The answer rack’s port touches the judge inlet through one straight arrow; add paired solid evidence tabs, fixed rubric stencil, contrasting fact and framing trays, and a centered support bed. No rankings, score bars, flags, or faces.

No transfer from this test to general capability, neutrality, independent human certification, or training-data overlap.

Visible text allowlist, exactly once per label and no other text: "Eval prompts", "Open weights", "Model answers", "Blind judge", "Facts and framing", "Publisher-designed test". Labels sit on white, never on a connector. Detached caveat occupies its own clean box and never participates in flow. Hold 52px planning inset from every edge; retain at least 40px whitespace to actual glyphs after export. Use the region and label boxes with font minima specified below, and attach every arrow tail and head to the exact exposed object port, clear of labels, frames and unrelated objects. Only the enumerated arrows are directional.
